main_body: Shrine building with a large sloped teal roof and a red/white front facade
top_band: Teal sloped roof surface from row 4 to row 42 (plus golden katsuogi ornaments at rows 0-3)
evidence: The building shows a prominent sloped roof surface (rows 4-42) above the vertical facade (rows 43-77). There is a clear front edge highlight along the lintel at row 43, eave/lintel shadow at rows 45-47, and the dark lattice doors (rows 47-72) are recessed behind the pillars and shimenawa.

style.evidence: The candidate matches the Beodeul reference standard well: the copper/teal roof has 6 distinct value steps with ribbed tile detailing, the plaster walls have subtle grain speckles rather than flat fills, the lattice doors and stone base are richly textured, and outlines use dark material tones (dark brown/teal/red-brown).
